question: ________ are carotenoid-accumulating plastids conferring colour to many flowers and fruits as well as to some tubers and roots.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chromoplasts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chromoplasts are carotenoid-accumulating plastids** conferring color to numerous flowers and fruits also to few **tubers and roots.**
 
• **Chromoplasts are coloured plastids** present in roots, leaves, flowers and ripe fruits.
